title: General.
officialText:
Plastic materials installed as interior finish or trim shall comply with Chapter 8. Foam plastics shall only be installed
as interior finish where approved in accordance with the special provisions of Section 2603.9. Foam plastics that are used as interior
finish shall also meet the flame spread index requirements for interior finish in accordance with Chapter 8. Foam plastics installed as
interior trim shall comply with Section 2604.2.
